title: Ariens APEX 60 Zero-Turn Lawn Mower – 60″ Deck, 24HP Kawasaki
description:
The
Ariens APEX 60
is built for power, precision, and durability. Featuring a 24 HP / 726 cc Kawasaki FR730V engine, a heavy-duty 60” ENVY™ Elite fabricated deck, and a fully tubular steel frame, this mower delivers professional-grade performance with unmatched comfort and reliability.
Key Features
Engine Power:
24 HP Kawasaki® FR730V, 726 cc displacement
Fuel Capacity:
5.1 gallons (19.3 L) for extended run time
Cutting Deck:
60” ENVY™ Elite fabricated deck, 10-gauge steel, 5.5” deep for superior airflow
Cutting Range:
Adjustable from 1.5” to 5” with 15 height positions
Spindle Material:
Forged aluminum for strength and durability
Deck Engagement:
Electric Warner clutch
Deck Lift:
Foot-operated with assist spring for ease of use
Frame:
Fully tubular steel construction for maximum durability
Comfort:
High-back padded seat with armrests
Drive System
Transmission:
Hydro-Gear® ZT-3100® dual hydrostatic transaxles
Ground Speed (Forward):
Up to 8 mph (12.9 kph)
Ground Speed (Reverse):
Up to 4 mph (6.4 kph)
Dimensions
Weight:
845 lbs (383.2 kg)
Length:
79 in (200.7 cm)
Width (Chute Up):
63.7 in (161.8 cm)
Width (Chute Down):
74.8 in (190 cm)
Warranty
Residential:
4 Years or 500 Hours (whichever comes first)
Additional Information
Optional accessories: lights, seat isolation, floor mat, and deck pan storage tray
Designed for comfort, durability, and precision mowing on large properties
The Ariens APEX 60 is engineered to deliver pro-level results—perfect for homeowners who demand commercial-grade power and performance.
